basic_info.description: Video Preview! Prime Pacific Heights location - 98 Walk Score - Full Floor, Recently Remodeled, View Apartment in a Classical, Elegant - 7 unit Co-op building that is detached on four sides. Beautiful Lobby. Private vestibule entrance. Living Room & Formal Dining Room have framed views of the SF Bay & Alcatraz. Great floor plan includes library + office that could be a 4th bedroom, laundry, eat-in kitchen. Easy access to the garage with 2 car side by side parking. Guest parking. Large storage room. Excellent resident manager.
